---
# Source: lapilli/templates/pdb.yaml
# Replicas sharing a Postgres ledger: a node drained takes so many at
# most, the rest serving, one of them leading.
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
spec:
  maxUnavailable: 50%
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
      app.kubernetes.io/component: serve
---
# Source: lapilli/templates/serviceaccount.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
automountServiceAccountToken: false
---
# Source: lapilli/templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
spec:
  # Inside the cluster: every port, as jobs, alert managers and Prometheus
  # reach them. The UI outside it is FULLNAME-ui's (serve.service.type).
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/component: serve
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: http
    # /metrics and the health checks, alone: what Prometheus needs.
    - name: metrics
      port: 9091
      targetPort: metrics
---
# Source: lapilli/templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
spec:
  replicas: 2
  strategy:
    # Replicas sharing a Postgres ledger (docs/design/replicas.md): one at
    # a time, each new pod a follower until the leader it replaces lets the
    # lease go, so the UI and the ports never all go.
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
      app.kubernetes.io/component: serve
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: serve
        app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
        helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: ops-lapilli
      # Mounted in lapilli's container alone, when a cloud's identity may
      # need it (lapilli.saToken), not in the rules history's.
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      # Told to stop, a replica answers for serve.shutdownDelaySeconds
      # first; then the 30 s Kubernetes gives, for the rest of its stop.
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 35
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 65532
        runAsGroup: 65532
        fsGroup: 65532
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: lapilli
          image: "ghcr.io/lapilli-project/lapilli:dev"
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          args:
            - serve
            - "--ledger-url-file=/var/run/lapilli/ledger/url"
            - --listen=:8080
            - "--metrics-listen=:9091"
            - "--shutdown-delay=5s"
            - "--every=1h"
            - "--settle=1h"
            - "--backfill=28d"
            - "--keep=400d"
            - "--digest=mon@09:00"
            - "--timeout=50m"
            - "--viewers=ana@example.com"
            - "--lang=en"
            - "--external-url=https://lapilli.example.com"
            - "--oidc-issuer=https://idp.example.com"
            - "--oidc-client-id=lapilli"
            - "--session-key-file=/var/run/lapilli/session-key/session-key"
            - "--user-claim=email"
            - "--groups-claim=groups"
            - "--tz=Etc/UTC"
            - "--prometheus=http://prometheus:9090"
            - "--rules=/etc/lapilli/rules/0"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: 9091
          env:
            - name: GOMEMLIMIT
              valueFrom:
                resourceFieldRef:
                  resource: limits.memory
                  # Said, not left to the API server's default ("0"): resourceFieldRef
                  # is atomic, so a GitOps diff of the applied fields sees the default
                  # as a change. "1" is the same value, in bytes.
                  divisor: "1"
          # Ready once the first run is done (serve.readinessPath), so a
          # load balancer sends people to a UI with something in it.
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /readyz, port: metrics}
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: metrics}
            periodSeconds: 30
            failureThreshold: 4
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
          resources:
            limits:
              memory: 1Gi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: ledger
              mountPath: /var/run/lapilli/ledger
              readOnly: true
            - name: rules-0
              mountPath: /etc/lapilli/rules/0
              readOnly: true
            - name: session-key
              mountPath: /var/run/lapilli/session-key
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: ledger
          secret:
            secretName: ledger-db
        - name: rules-0
          projected:
            sources:
              - configMap:
                  name: rules
        - name: session-key
          secret:
            secretName: lapilli-key
